name: Kitzbüheler Horn
kurzbeschreibung: The **Kitzbüheler Horn** is a 1,996-meter-high mountain with a panoramic cable car, summit restaurant, and **Dinosaurierpark**.
beschreibung: The **Kitzbüheler Horn** is located east of **Kitzbühel** and reaches an elevation of 1,996 meters. The **Hornbahn** cable car operates year-round from **Kitzbühel** to the mountain station at around 1,800 meters. From there, a roughly 45-minute ascent leads to the summit, offering panoramic views of the surrounding alpine landscape. On the mountain, several **hiking trails** of varying difficulty wind through the scenic terrain, along with a **via ferrata** and a themed trail. In winter, the **Horn** is part of the **Kitzbühel** ski area, featuring groomed downhill runs and cross-country ski tracks. The experience is further enhanced by several mountain huts and a viewing platform.
